slides.headline: 1) WRITE YOUR CLIENT UPDATE IN 30 SECONDS FLAT
slides.body:
Now ChatGPT already knows your day.

"Write a professional update for my client [Name] based on what I worked on today. Under 150 words. Focus on what I finished and what comes next"

slides.headline: 2) TURN TODAY'S WORK INTO A BILLING INVOICE
slides.body:
You quietly lose hours billing from memory.

"Based on what I worked on today, list my billable time entries. Project name, what I did, and how long it looks like I spent on each"

slides.headline: 3) WRITE YOUR TEAM STAND-UP THE NIGHT BEFORE
slides.body:
Writing a stand-up the morning it's due burns 10 minutes.

"Write my team stand-up for tomorrow. What I accomplished today, anything blocked, and what I'm tackling first. Under 100 words"

slides.headline: 4) FIND EVERY TASK YOU FORGOT TO FINISH TODAY
slides.body:
This prompt finds every open loop before you close your laptop.

"Look at everything I worked on today. List anything unfinished, unanswered, or needing a follow-up, with one sentence on what to do next"

slides.headline: 5) BUILD TOMORROW'S EXACT SCHEDULE TONIGHT
slides.body:
Computer History knows what's still open.

"Based on what I worked on today, give me my top 5 priorities for tomorrow. Rank by what costs most to delay"

slides.headline: 6) WRITE A FULL PROPOSAL BEFORE THE CALL ENDS
slides.body:
Discovery calls cost two hours after they end.

"I just finished a discovery call. Based on what I had open today, write a one-page proposal with scope, timeline, and a placeholder for pricing"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body:
You'll want these the first time you turn on Computer History. Save this post so the prompts are ready when you need them.

Daily AI news and real skills, every day.

caption:
Swipe through before you turn it on. ChatGPT just got a memory for your whole computer, and these 6 prompts turn that into real work done for you tonight 🧠

Client update written from your actual workday, billing time entries pulled from what ChatGPT tracked you doing, team stand-up ready the night before, every forgotten task found automatically, tomorrow's priorities ranked by what costs most to delay, full discovery proposal drafted before the call ends.

ChatGPT's Computer History changes what a prompt can do. Instead of explaining your day, the AI already has it. For business owners that means ChatGPT turns what you actually did into work that's already finished. Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
